title: Correct LN2 entry
purpose: Replace the values of an LN2 entry recorded wrongly, or withdraw it, keeping the original visible.
summary: Replace the values of an LN2 entry recorded wrongly, or withdraw it. The original stays visible.

tasks.title: Correct the entry
steps: Change the values, give the [[Reason for the correction]] and select [[Correct LN2 entry]].

tasks.title: Withdraw an entry recorded in error
steps: Tick [[Withdraw this entry]], give the reason and save.

good_to_know: The original entry stays, marked Corrected.
A withdrawn entry no longer counts in the change since previous.
Only the latest version of an entry can be corrected.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: The person who recorded the entry, and managers and administrators; anyone else is refused. When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice that gives the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee. An entry that was already corrected must be corrected through its newer version, and a withdrawn entry cannot be corrected.
The top of the form shows the vessel, the entry and who recorded it and when. The vessel and the kind of entry cannot change.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Entries are never edited or deleted. A correction adds a new entry that replaces the values of the old one, or withdraws it, and it always needs a reason; the original stays visible in the log marked Corrected and the new one is marked Correction (or Withdrawal).

items.label: Withdraw this entry
items.description: Tick when it was recorded in error and should no longer count. The values below are then ignored.

items.label: Reason for the correction
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. Do not enter donor, patient or participant names or other text that could identify a person.

items.label: Entry fields
items.description: The same fields as Record LN2 entry for that kind (When, How the level was read, levels and units, amount, supply dewar, delivery reference, outside provider, note) start with the current values.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Submitting with no value changed is refused with Nothing to correct. The corrected entry replaces the old one in the log and in the change since previous; the original stays in the audit trail with the reason.
